name: list_files
description: List files in a directory, respecting .gitignore. Use this to explore the project structure.

path.description: The directory path to list files for. Use '.' for the repository root.

name: read_file
description: Read the contents of a file. Returns the content with line numbers prefixed, which is essential for writing accurate patches.

path.description: The path to the file to read.

name: search_code
description: Search for a string or regular expression in the codebase using ripgrep. Returns exact matches with file paths and line numbers.

query.description: The string or regex query to search for.

path.description: Optional path to restrict the search to a specific directory or file.

name: apply_patch
description: Apply a unified diff patch to modify the codebase. Keep this as a secondary option if replace_file_content is not suitable.

diff.description: The unified diff string to apply. Must include proper '--- a/file' and '+++ b/file' headers.

name: replace_file_content
description: Replaces a specific block of text in a file with new content. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED over apply_patch for most edits.

file_path.description: The path to the file to modify.

target_content.description: The exact block of text to replace. Must match the file content exactly, including whitespace/indentation.

replacement_content.description: The new content to insert in place of the target_content.

name: run_tests
description: Run the test suite inside the sandboxed environment to verify if the issue is resolved.

test_ids.description: Optional list of specific test IDs (e.g. file paths or pytest node IDs) to run. If omitted, runs all tests.
